quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
quests.hint: Compare the two options for "red": one is a alveolar/postalveolar approximant, the other a alveolar lateral approximant. Listen closely for the difference between them.
quests.explanation: In "red", the target sound is /r/, made by curling the tongue back slightly without touching the roof of the mouth.
